# LoftPOS

> POS and management software for gaming cafes, restaurants, and cafes — billing, inventory, sessions, bookings, and reports.

## Product
LoftPOS is a multi-tenant cloud POS platform that combines gaming session billing, lounge booking software, membership management, restaurant and cafe POS, QR ordering, kitchen display, inventory, staff permissions, and analytics.

## Primary audiences
- Gaming cafe and PlayStation lounge owners
- Restaurant and cafe operators
- Esports and entertainment venue operators
- Multi-location / white-label hospitality networks

## Solution pages
- Gaming cafe POS: https://loftpos.com/solutions/gaming-cafe
- Restaurant POS: https://loftpos.com/solutions/restaurant
- Cafe POS: https://loftpos.com/solutions/cafe
- All solutions: https://loftpos.com/solutions

## Core capabilities
- Gaming café software: start, pause, extend, and settle timed sessions with food add-ons, overtime, GST, and branded receipts
- Booking software for gaming lounges: public slot bookings, capacity rules, admin block-outs, tournaments, and events
- Membership management software: memberships, prepaid packs, guest profiles, and repeat-visit workflows at checkout
- Restaurant POS, QR menus, kitchen display, inventory audit trail, expense ledger, and multi-branch control

## Pricing (INR)
